name: Kitanosu
description: Nezumi village that heard Horobi's wailing.

description_citations.text: "Horobi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kitanosu hears unsettling wailing; shaman Forked-Tongue identifies Horobi and advises sacrificing a life every third night it appeared.
timeline.quote: advised that the village must sacrifice a life to appease the spirit every third night it appeared

citation.text: "Horobi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The village leaders decide to sacrifice the mercenary Sonokura, luring him to the outskirts, binding him and cutting his leg tendons.
timeline.quote: his leg tendons cut to ensure he couldn't escape

citation.text: "Horobi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Horobi appears, drawn to Sonokura's suffering, and devours him, leaving bones and worms, absorbing his voice into its chorus.
timeline.quote: Sonokura's voice was absorbed into the kami's chorus of wails

citation.text: "Horobi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Forked-Tongue sits in her treasury, knowing the sacrifices keep Horobi away from her belongings.

citation.text: "Horobi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
